meta.description: A tappable list row with a leading asset slot, label and description, and a trailing chevron with optional counter. Merges the former Action List, Action List with Counter and Action List with Description.

verdict.title: Keep — all findings resolved
verdict.text: Rebuilt on node 4628:19843 in the 2026 Working File and renamed Action Row, merging the three former Action List siblings into TrailingContent (2) × State (4) × Density (2) = 16 variants, plus a hasDescription boolean. Interaction states now exist where there were none, the leading asset and counter are real Figma Slots, and layer and property naming matches the conventions the rest of the family settled on. All four DS Health traits pass; the only item still open is Code Connect, blocked until the native library exists.

overview.inContextNote: Action-list rows stack inside Settings / Profile / Help menus. A typical screen mixes variants with/without description and with/without trailing counter.

traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: Used across Settings, Help Center, Profile, Wallet sub-screens. Covers the main action-list row patterns.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Carries its own surface, dividers and state colors, and composes a chevron and counter from library instances. Nothing external required to render a complete row.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: TrailingContent, State and Density are orthogonal, Density is used exactly as §1 defines it, hasDescription carries the correct verb prefix, and TrailingContent matches View Only Field for the same concept. Every addressable layer is semantically named; the skeleton loader keeps working names by design.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: Asset Slot and Counter Slot are real Figma Slots, and the chevron and counter come from library instances — teams drop in content without detaching. Stacks cleanly into lists.

behavior.notes: Baseline row. Label in Neutral Dark (or Brand Blue on the Counter variant).
Label → #C2CFE5, chevron → #9BC5FD, CTA → #9BC5FD, counter bg stays #EEF2F9 but label → #C2CFE5.
Icon becomes a neutral ring; label + trailing become 16 px pill placeholders filled with #EEF2F9.
Action rows are tap targets — a pressed state (row tint + possibly label darken) is a baseline expectation for native.
TV / keyboard focus ring not defined. Android a11y also relies on it.

resolved.headline: Three Action List components merged into Action Row.
resolved.body: v2.0: Rebuilt on node 4628:19843 in the 2026 Working File and renamed Action Row. Action List, Action List with Counter and Action List with Description are now one set: the counter is a Trailing=Counter value, and the description is part of the row rather than a separate component. Confirmed as a permanent merge by the component owner. (C4 · Family)

resolved.headline: Variant matrix is orthogonal and complete.
resolved.body: v2.0: Trailing (CTA · Counter) × State (Default · Pressed · Disabled · Loading) × Density (Compact · Expanded) = 16 variants, all authored. Density is used exactly as §1 defines it — adjusting row height and padding, 56px against 64px — rather than gating content. (C2 · Property)

resolved.headline: Interaction states added.
resolved.body: v2.0: State now covers Default, Pressed, Disabled and Loading, where the original components had no state coverage at all. Pressed carries its own #F6F9FD surface. (C5)

resolved.headline: Leading asset and counter are real Figma Slots.
resolved.body: v2.0: Asset Slot and Counter Slot are SLOT nodes, and the chevron and counter are library instances. Teams can drop in real content without detaching — the composition pattern the rest of the family has converged on. (C6 · Slot)

resolved.headline: Frame naming aligned to the family.
resolved.body: v2.1: The two frames both called Container are now Row and TrailingGroup, and the spaced names are hyphenated to match the convention Toast, Upload File and Section Header settled on — Asset-Slot, Counter-Slot, Text-Container, Icon-Container, Bottom-Stroke. (C1)

resolved.headline: Trailing renamed to TrailingContent.
resolved.body: v2.1: The axis now carries the same name View Only Field uses for the same concept, satisfying §6 on consistent terminology. Any future component with a trailing area has one name to adopt rather than a choice between two. (C2 · Family)

resolved.headline: Text and action layer naming completed.
resolved.body: v2.2: #label → Label and #blurb → Description, mapping onto §3 — the content is supporting text beneath a label rather than the promotional summary Blurb denotes. leading icon → Leading-Icon and Action Button → Action-Button complete the hyphenated convention. (C1)

resolved.headline: hasDescription boolean added.
resolved.body: v2.3: Confirmed by the component owner — a hasDescription boolean now toggles the description line, restoring the label-only row the original Action List provided. Implemented as a boolean component property rather than a fourth variant axis, so the matrix stays at 16 rather than doubling. Not independently verifiable from the assessment tooling, which cannot read component property definitions. (C2 · Property)

resolved.headline: Nested Wrapper collision resolved.
resolved.body: v2.3: The Wrapper frame nested inside another Wrapper in the Loading variants is now Skeleton-Trailing, naming what it actually holds. (C1)

resolved.headline: Skeleton loader retained as authored.
resolved.body: v2.3: Closed by owner decision — the Loading variants keep their skeleton geometry as built, including the repeated trailing icon and line rectangle names. These are internal placeholder shapes with no property surface and no override target, so their names never reach a consumer or a Code Connect mapping — the same reasoning applied to View Only Field's wrapper frames. (C1)

recommendations.headline: Record State=Loading under the existing State/Status exception.
recommendations.body: Loading is a process status rather than an interaction state, the same shape as Error on the form fields. It falls under the exception already documented for that family rather than needing its own justification.

propertyMapping.description: TrailingContent, State and Density are the set’s three variant properties; hasDescription is the boolean the rebuild added. Asset-Slot, Leading-Slot (the CTA) and Counter-Slot are Figma Slots. Label and Description are text layers read from 4628:19844; whether they are exposed on the property panel, and the boolean’s default, are not readable with the plugin.

accessibility.ios: Whole row in Button; accessibilityLabel combines label and description.
The CTA is its own Button inside the row — two accessibility elements, not one.
accessibility.android: Separate TextButton with its own onClick; do not merge it into the row.

accessibility.ios: .accessibilityValue("3 items") on the row — a bare number is ambiguous.
Announce "Loading" once; .accessibilityHidden(true) on the placeholder bars.
accessibility.android: contentDescription = "Loading" on the skeleton container; placeholders cleared with clearAndSetSemantics.

accessibility.ios: 56 pt row ≥ 44 pt; 64 pt when Expanded.
accessibility.android: 56 dp row ≥ 48 dp; 64 dp when Expanded.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use CTA when the row carries a second action beside the tap, and keep it to one word.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t use CTA to repeat what tapping the row already does.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Counter for unread or pending counts; the pill is 24 px and takes up to two digits.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t put text or a status word in the Counter.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Expanded in Settings and Profile menus, Compact inside dense lists.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t mix Compact and Expanded rows in one list.

usageGuidelines.doText: Turn hasDescription off when the label says everything.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t leave the Description as filler under a self-explanatory label.

TrailingContent, State, Density with Title Case values; hasDescription is a real boolean.

Label resolves to Primary/Label/Base, Description to Primary/Multi-line Label/Light/Fine. Description is #6780A9 on the CTA variants and #90A8D0 on the Counter variants — one binding is wrong. Colour variable bindings are not readable with the plugin.
Three enums, one boolean, three slots and two text values — maps 1:1 onto EBActionRow.
Default, Pressed, Disabled and Loading built for both TrailingContent values and both densities.
Chevron Right is a vector instance; the CTA is a Leading instance and the counter a Counter instance, each inside a Slot.

changelog.header: Style and Code tabs re-read · node 4628:19843

rows.body: Style tab rebuilt from the 16 live variants. Cards follow TrailingContent — CTA, Counter — with State, Density and hasDescription as panel controls; colours, text styles and the 56 / 64 heights read off 4628:19844, 4628:19883 and the state variants. Padding, gap, alignment and colour tokens are not readable with the plugin and stay —; the row height with hasDescription off could not be read either.

Code tab regrouped on the TrailingContent × State × Density schema. Installation on the Action List family coordinates, Property Mapping one row per property with the three slots, Usage Snippets and Guidelines added, Scorecard regraded, Variants Inventory moved from the three sibling nodes to the 16 live nodes.

Description colour differs by TrailingContent. #6780A9 on the CTA variants, #90A8D0 on the Counter variants (4628:19844 vs 4628:19883). One binding is off. Filed from the scorecard for the Component Review.
One Expanded variant is Compact-height. 4649:16639 (CTA · Loading · Expanded) is 360 × 56; every other Expanded variant is 64. Filed from the scorecard for the Component Review.

Resolved issues recorded. 10 resolved issues on the Overview tab had no changelog row: Three Action List components merged into Action Row; Variant matrix is orthogonal and complete; Interaction states added; Leading asset and counter are real Figma Slots; Frame naming aligned to the family; Trailing renamed to TrailingContent; Text and action layer naming completed; hasDescription boolean added; Nested Wrapper collision resolved; Skeleton loader retained as authored.
Verdict: Restructure — Collapse 3 sibling components into one slot-driven List row. Reconcile label typography. Add Pressed state. Open
C1 — 3 siblings for 1 pattern — Description and Counter are additive features, not different components. Open
C1 — Spacer annotations leak — _space_2 / _space_16 are authoring artifacts exported as opacity-0 layers. Open
C2 — Divergent label typography — Semibold 16 Neutral vs. Bold 18 Brand across siblings. Same family must read as one. Open
C4 — Trailing baked per sibling — Replace CTA / Counter / Chevron booleans with a single trailing enum. Open
C5 — Missing Pressed state — Action rows are the primary nav tap target. Open
C6 — Placeholder icon — Leading is a gray #C2C6CF circle. Adopt a Figma Slot. Open
C7 — Code Connect — Blocked on consolidation. Open
Tokens ✓ — Colors / paddings / radii all bound to main/action-list/*. Noted
